injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.detail: Nov 23: Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Nov 20: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: Nov 17: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Nov 17: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Tobi Lawal
injuries.detail: Nov 23: Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: P.J. Washington
injuries.detail: Nov 23: Washington (illness) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.detail: Nov 24: Robinson (quadriceps) is considered day-to-day as he progresses in his rehab, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Ebuka Okorie
injuries.detail: Nov 24: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Nov 24: Duren (hamstring) is being assigned to the Motor City Cruise on Wednesday for practice as he ramps up for a return, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.detail: Nov 24: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Cade Cunningham
injuries.detail: Nov 23: Cunningham (knee) is probable for Tuesday's game against the Orlando.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Nov 18: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Nov 21: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Nov 14: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Oct 24: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: Jul 30: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Oct 28: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: Nov 2: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Nov 23: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Tre Mann
injuries.detail: Nov 24: Mann (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Tuesday's game against Boston.
